claims.statement: The Met dates the Parthian imperial era to 247 BCE–224 CE.
Trade supported patronage of sculpture, metalwork, jewellery and ceramics, combining Hellenistic and earlier Near Eastern traditions.

evidence.note: A broad imperial period, extending slightly beyond 200 CE. Artistic practices and frontiers changed over time; no fixed border or year-specific capital location is implied.
